messages:
elaine_finance: FYI: several NetSuite invoice imports failed overnight with "Invalid authentication: signature mismatch". A bunch of invoices are stuck in the 'pending' queue and MTD revenue is understated. Dashboard: https://redwood.internal/billing/failures/1772
mike_eng: I pulled the webhook relay logs. Our stripe->ns relay validates Stripe's signature using the value in secrets manager. It looks like the secret rotated yesterday during a key rollover and the relay didn't pick up the new key before retrying older events. Stripe retries came back with same sig header and we rejected them.
sam_billing: How many invoices impacted? Can we retry without creating duplicates? We don't want to double-post once the relay accepts them.
mike_eng: Quick count from the import queue: `SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ns_import_queue WHERE status='failed' AND failure_reason LIKE '%signature mismatch%';` -> 64 rows. IDs: we can export list if needed.
ops-bot: deploy: ns-relay v1.7.3 deployed by ci-bot at 2026-07-03T08:04Z :rocket:
mike_eng: Mitigation plan: 1) patch relay to accept last two secrets during a short rollover window (we already do in other services) 2) add dedupe using stripe_event_id before creating NetSuite invoice to ensure idempotency 3) enqueue a controlled retry job for the 64 failed events that marks "retrying_from_signature_fix". PR coming in ~30m.
elaine_finance: Good. Please also include a manual review report for the invoices in the 64 list so accounting can confirm amounts before we re-run imports. We can't have duplicates hitting NetSuite.
mike_eng: Will produce CSV with (event_id, stripe_invoice, customer_id, amount, original_attempt_ts). Sample SQL to extract: `SELECT source_event_id, stripe_invoice_id, customer_id, amount_cents, attempted_at FROM ns_import_queue WHERE status='failed' AND failure_reason LIKE '%signature mismatch%';`
nico_support: I'll add notes to the 64 customer tickets and send a proactive message saying we're on it. If any customers already raised disputes, add them to the priority list.
sam_billing: After the hotfix, before retrying, can we run a dry-run flow that simulates NetSuite payload creation and flags any potential validation errors? We need accounting sign-off to proceed with automated retries.
mike_eng: Yes — I'll wire a dry-run mode into the retry job and include the NetSuite validation response in the CSV. Also adding a short TTL to avoid re-retrying indefinitely.
elaine_finance: ETA for the hotfix and the retry window? We need fixes today for reporting cut-off.
mike_eng: Hotfix -> 45m, dry-run generation -> additional 20m, then review. If all good, we can run retries in a controlled batch and mark them processed. I'll post the PR and the CSV here when ready.
